text:
acme_sre: Hi, SSO started failing right after our IdP pushed a metadata refresh. Users hit a 400 from our ACS with: 'Invalid SAML Response: assertion audience mismatch'. Happening to all users.
jenna: sorry to hear that — can you paste the IdP metadata url and a minimal error log?
acme_sre: metadata: https://idp.acme-corp/internal/saml/metadata.xml
acme_sre: error snippet from our ACS: 
```
2026-03-15T18:42:07Z ERROR saml: validation failed: audience mismatch (expected https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs)
```
jenna: thanks — can you curl the metadata and paste headers? sometimes proxies or gzip break the fetcher.
mike: deploy-bot shows our metadata-sync job fetched the file at 18:41:55 and logged: 
```
metadata-fetcher: GET https://idp.acme-corp/internal/saml/metadata.xml -> 200, transfer-encoding: chunked, content-encoding: gzip, size: 0
```
jenna: size: 0 looks suspicious. If the fetcher decompress step failed we may have parsed an empty string and used stale cached EntityDescriptor or picked a partial DOM.
acme_sre: i ran local curl -v and got: 
```
> GET /internal/saml/metadata.xml HTTP/1.1
> Host: idp.acme-corp
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: application/samlmetadata+xml
< content-encoding: gzip
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< 
[compressed data]
```
sam: looking at a raw copy you pasted in support ticket, there are *two* <EntityDescriptor> blocks concatenated (IdP produced a combined feed). Our parser currently stops at the first EntityDescriptor and picks the first KeyDescriptor it sees. In your feed the first KeyDescriptor is marked <KeyDescriptor use="encryption"> and the signing KeyDescriptor comes later. We then tried to validate signatures with the wrong key.
jenna: that would cause an audience/signature validation cascade failure. Can you share a tiny snippet of the metadata around KeyDescriptor?
acme_sre: pasted below (sanitized):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme-corp">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="encryption">...cert A...</KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme-corp/secondary">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">...cert B...</KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
mike: thanks — two EntityDescriptor elements concatenated is nonstandard for our parser (we expect a single root EntityDescriptor or EntitiesDescriptor). The gzipped+chunked combo also triggered a streaming path that returned empty body to our old parser variant.
sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) ask IdP to ensure signing KeyDescriptor appears first or set use="signing" explicitly on the first KeyDescriptor; 2) we can flip our tenant override to supply a specific idp_signing_cert (short-term) so you don't depend on metadata ordering; 3) engineering can patch parser to handle multiple EntityDescriptor entries and prefer KeyDescriptor use="signing".
acme_sre: #2 works for now — can you tell me exact format for idp_signing_cert override? we deploy via SAML settings UI.
jenna: paste the PEM into the tenant setting field, no header/footer stripping. We'll do that for you if you send it privately. I'll also open an engineering ticket to make parser more tolerant.
mike: created ticket INF-1217 and assigned to eng-ml; linking logs and metadata sample.
jenna: repro steps for engineering in ticket:
```
1) Serve metadata.xml as chunked + gzip with two EntityDescriptor blocks concatenated.
2) Run metadata-fetcher in v1.3.2 (use redis cache TTL 30s)
3) Observe fetcher logs: size: 0 and parser selecting first KeyDescriptor regardless of use attribute.
```
sam: long-term we'll update parser to: prefer KeyDescriptor[@use='signing'], fall back to ds:KeyInfo with rsaKeyValue, and error clearly if no signing key found. Also add detection for multiple EntityDescriptor and prefer EntitiesDescriptor semantics.
acme_sre: thanks everyone. we'll upload the idp_signing_cert now and confirm. any ETA on eng fix?
mike: ENG triage done, target patch in next minor (2-week) release. I've flagged as P2 because there's a tenant override.
jenna: action items: jenna will accept idp_signing_cert via DM and enable override; mike will track INF-1217 updates; sam will draft parser compatibility notes. Closing thread once acme confirms SSO success. :thumbsup:
